arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Values from Treasury Bulletin March 2010
march_2009 = 6833543  # in millions
september_2009 = 7551862  # in millions

# Calculate absolute arc percent change
# Arc percent change = (New - Old) / ((New + Old) / 2) * 100

difference = september_2009 - march_2009
average = (september_2009 + march_2009) / 2

arc_percent_change = (difference / average) * 100

print(f"March 2009: {march_2009:,} millions")
print(f"September 2009: {september_2009:,} millions")
print(f"Difference: {difference:,}")
print(f"Average: {average:,}")
print(f"Arc percent change: {arc_percent_change:.6f}%")
print(f"Rounded to nearest thousandths: {arc_percent_change:.3f}%")
EOF
